## Claude Opus 5.5 Games & Playable Demos

### Pelican Bicycle Adventure

A playable coastal cycling game with cloth physics, day-night changes, fish collecting, adaptive quality and touch controls.

**Creator:** riba2534 · **Tools / format:** Three.js, Browser game, Procedural audio

riba2534 reports that Opus 5.5 built the game from one sentence in a single Claude Code session, with no manual code edits. The public repository contains the source and build instructions.
